name: io.arcaeon/adapter
title: Arcaeon Adapter
description: MCP stdio proxy that logs the tool-call seam to the ledger without the agent's cooperation

packageArguments.name: --ledger
packageArguments.description: Seam ledger file (required). Keep it separate from any ledger the wrapped server writes: one file, one writer.
Ends the adapter's own options; everything after it is the wrapped server's command.
The MCP server command to wrap, followed by its arguments, e.g. python -m arcaeon_ledger.mcp_server --log agent.log.jsonl
